body:
@patrakov:

There is an error in the new script concerning recalling the SMART root directory if this is **NOT**:

`SMART-X[.Y[.Z...]]-win64-portable`

In fact, in your script you set:
```
# SMART location
# If SMART.exe exists directly under this directory, it will be used.
# Otherwise, the script will search versioned SMART-*-win64-portable subdirectories (default portable layout).
$SmartRoot = $env:LOCALAPPDATA
```
and:
```
# ------------------- Locate SMART portable (newest version) -----------------

# Prefer a direct path (user override / non-versioned install)
$SmartExe = Join-Path $SmartRoot "SMART.exe"
```
In these condition, the SMART dir is **NOT** found.

I corrected the line above with the following one:
```
# Prefer a direct path (user override / non-versioned install)
$SmartExe = Join-Path $SmartRoot "SMART\SMART.exe"
```
and now tit works!

Regards,
Topoldo
